mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (id, post_id, user_id, author_type, reply_comment_id, content, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{postId}, #{userId}, COALESCE(#{authorType}, 'USER'), #{replyCommentId}, #{content}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id AS postId, c.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(c.author_type, 'USER') AS authorType, c.content, u.nickname, u.avatar, c.create_time AS createTime FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
